Name: Stardew-Doro
Author: YasserMez
Description:
[center][size=6]Stardew-Doro[/size]
[size=4]a Pomodoro mod 
[/size]
[size=6][img]https://i.ibb.co/x7JGt8N/sv3.jpg[/img][/size]﻿

An in-game pomodoro clock that allows the player to get rewards once the cycle is finished. taking advantage of the game interface.[/center][center]﻿
The rewards are random in-game objects. As the number of completed cycles of the pomodoro clock increases, the probability of obtaining fewer common objects increases.[/center]The game time pauses once the player starts or resumes the work cycle. Likewise, game time resumes if it is in the rest cycle.

[left][size=3]﻿[/size][/left][size=3]How to Use:[/size]

[list=1]
[*]Please add the generic mod config menu mod first
[*]When you enter to the game and load to your save, go to options and scroll all the way to the bottom You will find a Button named Mod Options
[*]Click Pomodoro Mod
[*]When you want to change how many sessions you want, you have to adjust the slider, click save and close.
[*]then click back on Pomodoro mod.
[*]then adjust the sessions as you want.
[*]When you're finished, click save and close.
[*]the sessions should start.
[*]When a session's time is moving, the game time is paused.
[*]when the session time is done, the game time resumes, and you get an item (but be sure your inventory has enough space or else the item won't be added!)
[*]If you want to pause the session, you can open the game menu.
[*]If you want to cancel the sessions entirely, go to mod options and pomodoro mod, then click default
[*]Have Fun and Be Productive :D

Support me [url=https://www.buymeacoffee.com/d06d60]here[/url]﻿

[/list]
